main.description: The gated content of a post, for moderators reviewing a report, whatever the gate conditions. Every call is logged (net.krao.gate.moderation.listAccessLog). Served by the gate service; requires service auth from a moderator account or moderation service it trusts.

reason.description: Why the content is read, eg a report id. Kept in the access log.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No gated content exists for this post.
